alertDisplayName: Unusual number of failed sign-in attempts
description:
A relatively high number of failed sign-in attempts were observed during a short period. This activity can indicate an attempt to brute-force credentials.

For more information, read the IoT devices and Linux-based systems targeted by OpenSSH trojan campaign Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/59e6e47e-9992-4d3c-b46e-d5cd825d89c6/analystreport?

Brute force attempt for user 'Account: target-linux\user  - 4294967295'
name: 2c90b1c6-e0d9-430d-8ef4-3f140d022721
remediationSteps: 1. Make sure the machine is completely updated and all your software has the latest patch.
2. Contact your incident response team.
3. Install and run MicrosoftÆs Malicious Software Removal Tool (see https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/malicious-software-removal-tool-details.aspx).
4. Run MicrosoftÆs Autoruns utility and try to identify unknown applications that are configured to run at login (see https://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/bb963902.aspx).
5. Run Process Explorer and try to identify unknown running processes (see https://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/bb896653.aspx).
